heading: Scope
text: This Regulation applies to every regulated entity, covered institution and licensed firm that processes personal data in the course of business.

heading: Scope
text: Nothing in this Regulation limits the powers of the Supervisory Authority under any other enactment.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to customer data includes client data and consumer data.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to employee data includes staff data and personnel data.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to vendor data includes supplier data and contractor data.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to payment data includes transaction data and remittance data.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to marketing data includes promotional data and advertising data.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to biometric data includes fingerprint data and facial-recognition data.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to location data includes geolocation data and positioning data.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to health data includes medical data and clinical data.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to credit data includes lending data and loan data.

heading: Definitions
text: A reference to account data includes deposit data and savings data.

heading: Definitions
text: "Records" includes files and documentation.

heading: Definitions
text: "Complaints" includes grievances and disputes.

heading: Definitions
text: "Consent forms" includes authorisations and permission slips.

heading: Definitions
text: "Transfer agreements" includes data-sharing contracts and export arrangements.

heading: Definitions
text: "Risk assessments" includes impact evaluations and hazard reviews.

heading: Definitions
text: "Access logs" includes audit trails and usage journals.

heading: Definitions
text: "Security incident" includes any data breach or unauthorised disclosure.
